correctness.rationale: The complete-pair Gini seminorm admits an exact binary-cut reduction by layer cake and triangle inequality for every real input. The read RESULT.md proves the leakage identity with F(u1,u2)=u1²+2u1u2+2u2² and an all-n endpoint imbalance case split d in {-2,-1,0,1,2}; the second-coordinate spike saturates the n>=9 bound. Independently enumerated all 2^n-2 cuts for each n=2..11, reproducing rational sharp coefficients 0,1/2,1-1/(2 floor(n²/4)) at n=4..8 and 1+(n-9)/(4(n-1)) at n=9..11. Source script check_exact.py exhaustively covers n<=16, but it was inspected, not presumed run. Universal n>=9 is established analytically, not by enumeration.
